people.name: Abimelech
people.line: Son of Gideon, self-proclaimed king of Shechem

translations.web: Abimelech fought against the city all that day; and he took the city and killed the people in it. He beat down the city and sowed it with salt.
translations.bsb: And all that day Abimelech fought against the city until he had captured it and killed its people. Then he demolished the city and sowed it with salt.
translations.kjv: And Abimelech fought against the city all that day; and he took the city, and slew the people that was therein, and beat down the city, and sowed it with salt.
translations.asv: And Abimelech fought against the city all that day; and he took the city, and slew the people that were therein: and he beat down the city, and sowed it with salt.
